additional_analytical_decisions: Infer an endogenous common-share payout from a preference waterfall, mandatory and value-dependent conversions. Find owner funding requirements across a discontinuous contractual trigger, including an unattained infimum. Share voting power, reported carrying value and simple fully converted ownership do not determine cash entitlement.
reference_method: Executable economic model with a separate derivation, valid alternative SQL and financial invariant checks

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Reorder all rows without changing their identities or rights.

controls.name: scale
controls.rationale: Double issued shares and every aggregate cash amount and threshold. Per-share rights and per-share payouts stay fixed.

controls.name: carrying_only
controls.rationale: Change preferred book carrying values alone. Contractual liquidation rights do not change.

controls.name: trigger_lower
controls.rationale: Lower only the synthetic contractual mandatory-conversion threshold to USD 120 million.

controls.name: trigger_higher
controls.rationale: Raise the synthetic mandatory threshold above some voluntary conversions. Remaining rights are unchanged.

controls.name: junior_seniority
controls.rationale: Promote the synthetic A-1 claim to the same liquidation rank as other preferred claims. This changes distressed recoveries, not share counts.

controls.name: preference_right
controls.rationale: Give synthetic Series E a 1.5-times liquidation preference and adjust its contextual preference observation. Original issue price and conversion ratio stay fixed.

controls.name: conversion_ratio
controls.rationale: Give synthetic Series E 1.2 common shares per preferred share. Issued preferred shares, issue price, preference and other rights stay fixed.

controls.name: target_shift
controls.rationale: Replace the Series F target near the discontinuity with USD 55 million, which requires a larger attained funding amount.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No candidate trials before initial freeze. Source groups are separate from development tasks. Published references remain a contamination risk.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen financial scorer reused. Experimental SQL worker 1.0.1 permits zero-column reads for ordinary COUNT/EXISTS and CTE inputs and keeps temporary query storage within the unchanged memory allowance. Schema/module and filesystem restrictions remain. Qualified GLM uses 3600 seconds and 24 turns. Native Sol uses 3600 seconds and has no equivalent turn cap.
